references.text: Barak is mentioned again together with Deborah in the song of victory after the triumph over Sisera.
Barak, son of Abinoam, is urged to lead his captives away, fulfilling Deborah's prophecy.
Zebulun and Naphtali are mentioned as the tribes that risked their lives on the battlefield at Tabor.
Kadesh in Naphtali is mentioned as one of the cities of refuge, the same place Barak came from.
Kadesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali was given to the Levites, the same city Barak was from.
Samuel mentions Barak as one of the deliverers the Lord sent to save Israel.
Barak is mentioned in Hebrews as an example of faith, along with other heroes from Israel's history.
The tribe of Naphtali and their muster are mentioned, the same tribe Barak belonged to.
Moses' blessing over Naphtali, the tribe Barak came from.
